lines.text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Jabez called out to the God of Israel to bless him and enlarge his territory, and God granted his request.
Mered's wife Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah.
Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, so his clan became as numerous as the sons of Judah.

wrong_details.wrong: his clan became as numerous as the sons of Judah
wrong_details.true: their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah

lines.text: In the days of Hezekiah, five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Carmel and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites.
